title: BananaPlant
description: This mod add bananaplant and banana
body:
![BananaPlant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00e01ed8cbeba817aed6117a5f8d2bf6ef514d05_0.webp)This mod adds a banana plant, a banana, throwable banana peels, and seeds for growing banana plants. The mod also automatically generates banana plants throughout the world: they can be found in jungles and on sandy beaches. This mod slightly expands farming options.
